categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches the Private Broadcast label prior and touches private broadcast state tracking for peer transaction dispatch and echo verification.
categories.rationale: Extends `getprivatebroadcastinfo` to allow node operators to inspect finished broadcast details, such as dispatch peers and network echo status. PR description notes this allows 'inspection of when and to whom the transaction was sent as well as when/if it was echoed from the network.'
